name: Blue Door Bistro
hook: Your last Google review was two months ago, and 47% of diners skip a place with under 20 recent reviews. You have the food; the map just does not know it yet.
praise: Brunch, especially the shrimp and grits
talkingPoints: Riverside Grill has six times your review count with a lower-rated kitchen. Volume, not quality, is the gap.
Three of your last ten reviews name a server. The report would tell you who, every month.
Weekend waits come up twice. A card on the table costs nothing and turns that wait into a review while they are still happy about the food.
likelyObjection: "We already have a QR code on the receipt." Answer: receipts get folded into wallets; the card asks at the table, while the meal is still a feeling.
